inlines.v: TRINITA'RIAN, adjective Pertaining to the Trinity, or to the doctrine of the Trinity. TRINITA'RIAN, noun One who believes the doctrine of the Trinity. 1. One of an order of religious, who made it their business to redeem christians from infidels.
